description: Unit tests for the NTLM HTTP authentication handler in Chromium, focusing on NTLM message creation, challenge handling, and authentication flow.

classes.name: HttpAuthHandlerNtlmPortableTest
classes.description: Test fixture for NTLM HTTP authentication handler unit tests, including setup for mock credentials and helper methods for challenge handling and token generation.

methods.name: CreateHandler
methods.description: Creates an NTLM auth handler for testing.

methods.name: CreateNtlmAuthHeader
methods.description: Encodes a buffer into an NTLM authorization header string.

methods.name: HandleAnotherChallenge
methods.description: Processes an NTLM challenge string and returns the result.

methods.name: GenerateAuthToken
methods.description: Generates an authentication token using the handler.

methods.name: ReadBytesPayload
methods.description: Reads bytes from a NTLM buffer into a span.

methods.name: ReadStringPayload
methods.description: Reads bytes from a NTLM buffer into a string.

methods.name: ReadString16Payload
methods.description: Reads bytes from a NTLM buffer into a UTF-16 string.

methods.name: GetGenerateAuthTokenResult
methods.description: Helper to generate auth token and get result code.

methods.name: GetAuthHandler
methods.description: Returns the current NTLM auth handler.

methods.name: MockRandom
methods.description: Mocks randomness for testing, filling output with 0xaa.
